versions.changelog:
CoverCraft Skill v2.0 introduces a comprehensive workflow and best practices for producing high-performance, safe, and scalable cover/thumbnail designs across Chinese and global content platforms.

- Strategy-driven system: Transforms content titles, references, and user goals into actionable cover production briefs and iteration plans.
- Multi-platform support: Provides platform-adaptive strategies, no-text image prompts, and typographic guides tailored to Bilibili, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat Channels, and more.
- Strong reference logic: Learns visual logic from reference covers, ensuring originality and IP safety—never directly copies layouts or copyrighted materials.
- Consistent portrait asset generation: Maintains character likeness across covers, enabling reusable image assets and batch production.
- Quality control and A/B/C variants: Outputs multiple cover directions with detailed QC checks and optimization strategies.
- Clear usage boundaries: Includes strict guidelines to avoid overpromising, aesthetic cliches, risky content, and identified copyright issues.
